label: Bible Study
prompt: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be _____ of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verse: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
note: The prophet Azariah's word to King Asa — a promise and a warning wrapped in one sentence.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy _____.
verse: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
note: God blots out transgressions 'for mine own sake' — and then chooses not to remember them.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Saul cast the _____; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verse: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
note: Saul's jealousy took aim: he cast the javelin, and David sidestepped — twice.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the _____ of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verse: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
note: Paul's one boast: the cross, which ended his relationship with the world in both directions.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Not _____ in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verse: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
note: 'Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord' — Paul's whole work ethic in nine words.
